title: R-6: companion and automation behaviour Kitty can be trusted to run on its own
description: R-6 follows kitty-studio-r4-v1 and kitty-studio-r5-v1 in the rollout order and covers what Kitty does on its own behalf: proactive surfacing and scheduled behaviour. The canonical direction is docs/frontend/KITTY_STUDIO_EXPERIENCE.md (Kitty presence and voice), which is accepted but not tracked on main — it lives on the preserved design branch design/kitty-reimagine-20260910 at 3bc3c9e2. The functional contracts come from the unactivated drafts docs/packets/OK-COMPANION-01.md and docs/packets/OK-AUTOMATIONS-01.md; this initiative does not re-derive them and does not activate them. Both packets are repairs to verified defects on main (2026-09-17, 7dd703c7): a garbled expert-model reply crashes the proactive evaluation and can dead-letter Jacob's watched CSV, and every schedule edit from the Automations surface wipes metadata the editor never sent. Every gate is a Python gate that runs in a Builder worktree today; no Node tooling appears in validation_commands because builder-frontend-proof-v1 has not landed. Packets run in sequence because they share the tests directory. Verified findings that are real but deliberately not activated here are recorded in the companion docs: gateway/proactive_insights.py is inert with a docstring naming callers that do not exist; experts.poll, nudges.check and the life.* actions are registered but never seeded into the startup schedule (a spend and product decision, not a repair); and the Automations surface has no run-now control, no run history and no next-run time on its rows even though the backend routes exist. Companion docs: docs/packets/R6-00.md and docs/packets/R6-01.md.

packets.title: A garbled expert answer stops cleanly instead of eating the file
packets.objective: Make the expert evaluation path end cleanly when a model reply does not match the agreed reply format: no exception, no signal with missing fields, no dead-letter move of a watched file, and no inbox capture returned to a state that is re-polled forever. This packet edits existing files only and creates no new production files.
acceptance_criteria: a model reply that contains no [Headline] line ends the evaluation without raising, asserted by a test that calls the evaluation function directly
such a reply emits no expert.suggestion signal, asserted over the signal store
a watched CSV file whose reply is unparseable stays in its directory and is never moved to the dead-letter queue by a formatting failure
an inbox capture whose reply is unparseable is marked triaged instead of returning to a state that is claimed again on the next poll
a formatting-only failure produces no user-visible error signal, and the recorded log warning does not contain the model reply text
the existing expert regression test passes unchanged, so the formatted path still emits exactly the signals it emitted before

packets.title: Editing a schedule stops deleting the fields the editor never sent
packets.objective: Make a schedule edit that does not supply a timezone keep the schedule's stored metadata instead of replacing it with an empty object, so editing the morning brief or a loop from Automations cannot silently drop its stored timezone or description. This packet edits existing files only and creates no new production files.
acceptance_criteria: a schedule edit that does not supply a timezone keeps the schedule's stored timezone, asserted through the route against a schedule holding America/Regina
a schedule edit that does not supply a timezone keeps every other stored metadata key, including a loop description
a schedule edit that does supply a timezone still replaces it, asserted by the existing replacement test passing unchanged
creating a schedule with no timezone still stores no timezone metadata, asserted by the existing create test passing unchanged
a missing schedule still returns the existing 404 message, so the Automations surface's error text does not change
